answer: In an agent economy, require each account to lock a scarce, externally issued credential bond before it can submit bids, and slash that bond when independent audits prove coordinated fake identities are farming rewards. A mirror check can compare agents’ signed histories for shared control, while a plume of linked accounts raises the audit rate; legitimate agents keep their bonds, but an attacker must acquire and immobilize more real collateral for every Sybil identity. A cedar-backed registry can make those bond claims publicly verifiable.
